nai.positive: painterly, oil painting (medium), dark fantasy, realistic proportions, muted colors, rim lighting, dramatic lighting, visible brush strokes, high contrast, detailed
nai.negative: chibi, cel shading, flat color, simple shading, anime coloring, 3d, photo

gpt.style: Painted dark-fantasy illustration in the manner of premium collectible card-game art: semi-realistic proportions, a muted palette with a single accent colour, strong rim light, visible oil-paint brushwork, dramatic chiaroscuro.
gpt.avoid: Avoid chibi or cartoon proportions, flat cel shading, photographic realism and a 3D-render look.
